# Ramble

> Talk to your Apple Watch. Your agent handles it. Your watch is all you need: tap it and talk; the iPhone transcribes it and passes the text to your agent, which picks it up on a schedule. No accounts.

Pairing: in Ramble on iPhone, Settings → Connect agent gives a single-use code. Tell your agent "I downloaded Ramble, connect it" and paste the code. The agent then pulls new transcripts and acknowledges them, which deletes them. Anything never picked up is deleted after 30 days. Audio never goes to the relay.

Relay: https://ramble-transcription-proxy.jpoliachik.workers.dev

Ramble can also send each transcript to any HTTPS endpoint (webhooks).

## Docs

- [Full reference](https://ramble.watch/llms-full.txt): Agent connection, the relay API, and the webhook API.
- [Connect your agent](https://ramble.watch/docs): Pairing, the agent loop, and the relay API.
- [Webhooks](https://ramble.watch/docs/webhooks): Payload format, signature verification, retries, automation platforms.
- [Requirements and troubleshooting](https://ramble.watch/docs/help): Minimum iOS and watchOS, and fixes for a missing watch app, recordings stuck on the watch, transcription errors, and an agent that isn't picking up.

Requirements: iPhone on iOS 26.2 or later. Apple Watch on watchOS 10.0 or later (Series 4 and later, any SE, any Ultra). If the watch app doesn't appear after installing, the watch is usually on an older watchOS.
